content.title: Why Perma-Fix (PESI) Stock Is Up Today
content.summary: Shares of environmental waste treatment and services provider Perma-Fix (NASDAQ:PESI) jumped 4.5% in the afternoon session after the stock's positive momentum continued as the company reported strong third-quarter 2025 financial results, which included revenue growth and a significantly smaller loss than the previous year.

content.title: PESI Q3 Deep Dive: Treatment Segment Growth and PFAS Commercialization Drive Outlook
content.summary: Environmental waste treatment and services provider Perma-Fix (NASDAQ:PESI) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 3.8% year on year to $17.45 million. Its non-GAAP loss of $0.10 per share was 16.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
